answer: Split each answer across three independent auditors drawn from separate subnets, and require two matching scores before payout. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch they skip, so a dormant farm decays while it waits. Numbers: one fake account needs three auditors who never share an operator, and a farm of fifty must hold 150 independent review slots. Basalt does not bend and neither does that ratio. The only inlet is honest review, and a sable account that stops working loses its seat.
